title: Tiny Fields: Learning α-Blended Scenes in O(n²) Time
abstract: This is a made-up paper, for the example page. We present Tiny Fields, a scene representation small enough to fit in a cache line and fast enough to render a new view in real time. A field of a few hundred α-blended points, fitted to a handful of input views, renders at 95% of real time on a laptop and matches larger methods on three benchmarks. Code and data are available.

teaser.caption: Tiny Fields fits a small field of α-blended points to a few input views, then renders a new view in real time.
teaser.alt: Two input views of a scene, a small field of points, and a rendered new view.
